title: SEAT BELT & SHOULDER HARNESS
summary: Seat belts (lap belts and buckles) for both seats, plus the coupe (19437) shoulder harness that runs from behind the seat over the guide pin on the seat back. Belt ends are bolted to floor anchors beside and behind the seats, a fitting behind the seat is bolted down through a hole in the carpet (View B), and a cable assembly is held to a plate by a lock nut (View A). Boots cover the belt ends; a small clip is screwed on near the front of the seat.

parts.name: SHOULDER HARN. ASM CHART (19437)
parts.name_expanded: Shoulder harness assembly (see chart), coupe only

fastening.note: Main view, right seat: one bolt [4] goes sideways through the belt bracket into the anchor at the inboard side of the seat, the other through the eye of the outboard belt end into the floor anchor beside the seat.
View B (arrow B, behind the seat by the rear quarter trim panel): bolt [5] goes down through the anchor fitting and the hole in the carpet into the floor; a tab on the fitting locates in the floor.
View A (arrow A): the end bracket of cable [6] goes over a stud on the plate asm and is held by lock nut [8] from below; the cable is tab-crimped at the assembly.
